package.name: chrono_supervisory_fmu_hw_interface
package.description: hardware_interface::SystemInterface plugin for the 분산 버전 (distributed version): runs alongside ros2_control and the supervisory controller (the machine/process hosting the autonomy stack -- "PC1" in the 2-machine framing), while the FMU dynamics run on a separate machine ("PC2", chrono_split_dynamics_node, reused unchanged). ONE bridge -- chrono_split_msgs VehicleCommand/VehicleStatus (Bridge 2's protocol, deg/N*m) -- not two: this plugin owns the velocity->torque control logic itself (ported from chrono_ros2_control's ChronoFmuSystemInterface) instead of delegating it to a middle "virtual ECU" node, since there is no real-ECU/CAN boundary to mirror here, only a network boundary between the supervisory controller and the physics. See ../../README.md.
